datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Mozambique in 2011. Geographic data representing food insecurity phases were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML) for January, April, July, and October 2011 near-term projections, with attributes including classification scale, scenario, and assistance eligibility status.
